creature_families: Body-scale tiers: 11 race rows at scale 3.0 (giant category) and 13 rows at 0.3 or less, two of them zero-scale and invisible (config/race_models.json)
Gender-variant rule: 44 race rows carry a separate female code (config/race_models.json)
Animation borrowing: 9 rows name another race's animation source; 11 rows carry a fallback code (config/race_models.json)
Race sound sets: 98 race prefixes, seven sound types each (attack, damage, death, idle, special, run, walk), base file plus up to three numbered variants (src/client/audio/creature_sounds.cpp)
Ambient flocks: seven flock types across ten biome cases with day and night sets; bats in dungeon and cave (src/client/graphics/environment/boids_manager.cpp)
Size-banded melee reach: dragon-band race ids get a 1.5 size factor, giant-band ids 1.3 (src/client/combat.cpp lines 1251-1253)
Escalation: none in the client; the server half that holds levels and spawns is absent from the box

top_creatures.label: Giant body tier
top_creatures.why: One scale value sets a large silhouette and a longer melee band the player can see.
top_creatures.keep: A size field that drives reach and camera framing.
top_creatures.change: Our own giant silhouettes, readable at 375 wide, with scale read from our own data file.

top_creatures.label: Tiny body tier
top_creatures.why: Very small bodies read as a crowd or dust at distance.
top_creatures.keep: A size floor for swarm bodies.
top_creatures.change: A clump silhouette for the swarm, not a small copy of any body.

top_creatures.label: Size-banded melee reach
top_creatures.why: A large body gets a longer band, and the player can see the difference.
top_creatures.keep: Reach that scales with target size.
top_creatures.change: The band comes from our race data, not from race-id ranges.

top_creatures.label: Day flyers and night bats
top_creatures.why: The same ambient slot changes with the sun, so the zone feels different at night.
top_creatures.keep: A day and night swap of the ambient set.
top_creatures.change: Our own day and night creatures with a dusk blend.

top_creatures.label: Enclosed-zone ambient
top_creatures.why: Dungeons and caves always carry the same ambient flyer, which marks them as enclosed.
top_creatures.keep: A fixed ambient for enclosed zones.
top_creatures.change: Our own cave ambience, not bats.

top_creatures.label: Harsh-biome thinning
top_creatures.why: Snow and volcanic zones carry fewer ambient creatures, which sells the harshness.
top_creatures.change: One ambient creature in snow, of our own design.

top_creatures.label: Creature sound set
top_creatures.why: Seven events per race, each with numbered variants, make a creature readable by ear.
top_creatures.keep: The event list and the numbered-variant rule.
top_creatures.change: Our own idle and damage cues, sized for a 375-wide view.

top_creatures.label: Ambient flock director
top_creatures.why: A flock cap, a spawn cooldown and an expiry keep the ambient set bounded.
top_creatures.keep: The cap, the cooldown and the expiry.
top_creatures.change: A grace despawn when the area empties, and our own flyers.

classes: 16 player class ids (src/client/combat.cpp line 1039); names and progression not in the box
Races: 185 rows in config/race_models.json, playable and creature mixed, no flag to tell them apart
Factions: none in the client; hostility and ally checks are TODO stubs keyed on class id (combat.cpp lines 1031-1039)
weapon_families: No weapon table in the box. Visual families only:
Damage-type colour keys: none, magic, fire, cold, poison, disease, chromatic, corruption (config/spell_effects.json line 7)

Spell visual styles: cast spray (line 18), cast glow (line 41), spell complete ring, impact burst, buff aura, projectile trail, projectile impact, spell rain, ground circle (config/spell_effects.json styles block)
Global particle cap of 1024 with a density multiplier (config/spell_effects.json global block)
gear_tiers: No armour or gear tier table in the box.
data/item_models.json maps 3661 item ids to model numbers (a lookup, not a set list); loader at src/client/graphics/entity_renderer.cpp lines 2339-2342 (per AU057, not re-read).
zones: Biome archetypes (ambient switch, src/client/graphics/environment/boids_manager.cpp lines 274-354): forest, swamp, desert, plains, urban, ocean, dungeon, cave, volcanic, snow, with a default
Zone links: 106 zone-line entries, 117 per-zone files, 582 zone points (data/zone_lines.json, data/zone_lines/, data/zone_points.json)
Weather states: calm, normal, rain, storm; four rain slots summed out of 400, then a storm, rain or normal split, and a 20 percent calm roll (src/client/graphics/weather_system.cpp lines 202-240)
Storm look: lightning every 10 to 30 seconds, branch depth 4, storm fog multiplier, storm cloud dome (config/weather_effects.json)
Rain and snow overlays: layered scrolling sheets, daylight reduction for rain, sky darkening and fog reduction for snow (config/weather_effects.json)
Tree motion per weather: calm 0.5, normal 1.0, rain 1.5, storm 2.5 (config/tree_wind.json)
Ambient emitters: dust, pollen, fireflies, mist, sand dust, embers, smoke, detail objects, boids, tumbleweeds; several disabled by default (config/environment_effects.json)

looks.label: Spell style split
looks.technique: Each spell picks cast spray or cast glow; the spray is a short cone from the caster and the glow orbits, with lifetime set to the cast time.

looks.label: Storm lightning with branches
looks.technique: Lightning on a random interval with a short flash and a branch depth limit.

looks.label: Storm cloud dome
looks.technique: A dome of scrolling cloud frames with timed blends and an opacity cap, brightness set by dawn and dusk bands.

looks.label: Tree motion by weather
looks.technique: A wind multiplier per weather state scales tree sway.

looks.label: Footprints and grass push
looks.technique: Player position pushes foliage with a radius and displacement, and leaves footprint decals with a fade.

looks.label: Consider colour ring
looks.technique: Six threat colour bands from the level difference between player and target.

originals.name: Cast Spray and Cast Glow Pair
originals.idea: Each spell picks one of two styles: a short cone from the caster, or an orbiting glow; the lifetime equals the cast time.
originals.keep: Two styles, a colour from the spell, and lifetime equal to the cast time.
originals.change: Our gold and smoke palette and a ring burst at the end of the cast.

originals.name: Storm Front Timer
originals.idea: Weather checked on an interval, with a duration per weather and a 10-second blend between states.
originals.keep: The check interval, per-weather duration and the blend.
originals.change: Fog and light dimming instead of rain particles, and one forecast cue on the HUD.

originals.name: Dual-State Ambience Bed
originals.idea: Two variants of one ambient loop, crossfaded by a flag over two seconds.
originals.keep: Two variants, a crossfade, and one flag.
originals.change: Switch on combat state rather than time of day, with a low-health third variant.

originals.name: Radius Emitter With Fade Band
originals.idea: An emitter with a radius and a per-emitter gain, fading to silence at the edge.
originals.keep: The radius and the per-emitter gain.
originals.change: A fade band at the edge instead of a hard cut (fixes the defect below).

originals.name: Ambient Flock Director
originals.idea: A flock cap, a spawn cooldown and an expiry keep an ambient set bounded.
originals.keep: The cap, the cooldown and the expiry.
originals.change: A grace despawn when the area empties, and our own flyers (engine row 23 zone population).

originals.name: Size-Banded Reach
originals.idea: Melee reach grows with the target's size, using bands per size category.
originals.keep: Reach that grows with target size.
originals.change: A band read from our own race table, with our own categories (engine row 4 fight loop).

originals.name: Consider Colour Bands
originals.idea: Six threat colour bands from the level difference.
originals.change: Five bands with a shape cue, so colour is not the only signal (engine row 14 HUD, readability at 375 wide).

originals.name: Day and Dusk Ambient Swap
originals.idea: The ambient creature set swaps with the sun and blends over a dusk band.
originals.keep: The day and night set swap.
originals.change: Our own creatures and a dusk blend using a dawn and dusk band (engine row 16 colour grade).
